description: Search domains available for paid rental on Popdot AI. Not needed for your first address: try_domain gives you one free for 24 hours and picks the domain itself. Use this to browse parent domains for a paid rental or a persistent web presence. Returns domains with pricing, tier, availability and trialEligible. No auth required.

emotion.description: Filter by the reaction the domain is built to elicit: comedy, absurd, playful, edgy, wholesome, professional, trustworthy. Unknown values are ignored.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

query.description: Search query to match against domain names, tags, and categories
